question: Should Workspaces permanently support `builtin:chart` as a first-party trusted widget instead of leaving chart rendering to approved custom widgets?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded, but it expands the supported trusted-widget product contract; code review cannot determine whether OpenClaw wants to own that built-in surface long term.

options.title: Sponsor the trusted chart
options.body: Accept the numeric-only built-in direction, then require locale synchronization and final-head live UI proof before merge.

options.title: Keep charts custom
options.body: Retain the existing scaffolded custom-widget path and close or narrow this PR rather than adding another permanent built-in.

options.title: Defer with the roadmap
options.body: Leave the PR open but paused until the broader Workspaces roadmap receives explicit product sponsorship.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the trusted chart
recommendation.body: Accept the numeric-only built-in direction, then require locale synchronization and final-head live UI proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a permanent first-party Control UI product-surface decision rather than a mechanical implementation choice.
